(8) The Deputy Governor of the Central Bank appointed
under subsection (7) shall be designated as the acting Chief
Executive Officer of the Central Bank.
(9) (a) Where the Governor of the Central Bank vacates or
ceases  to  hold  office  for  any  reason,  the  Senior  Deputy
Governor  of  the  Central  Bank  appointed  in  terms  of
subsection (2) of section 16 shall act as the Chief Executive
Officer of the Central Bank.
(b)  Where  the  Senior  Deputy  Governor  of  the  Central
Bank referred to in paragraph (a) is unable to act as the Chief
Executive Officer for any reason, the acting Chief Executive
Officer designated in terms of subsection (8) shall act as the
Chief Executive Officer of the Central Bank.
(10) The office of the Governor of the Central Bank shall
not remain vacant for a period of more than forty-five days.
